Weather conditions: air temperature 59 degrees, relative humidity 65 percent, barometer 29.98 inches, adjusted
altitude 1,525 feet, track temperature 83 degrees.

Hagan is 20 - 7 against Todd in prior events. 

This is just the fifth time that all top four qualifiers made the semifinals, the last time was 2022.

Hagan with a slight starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He makes his quickest pass of the
weekend for the win.

Todd is up in smoke early.

This is the first time Capps and Vandergriff have faced each other in eliminations. 

Capps with a slight starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He make the quickest pass of the
event for the win.  He advances to his 159th final round.  Capps will have lane choice over Hagan in the
final.

Vandergriff with his career quickest pass in the losing effort.
